title: Harbison Labor-Only Protection: Holder Confirmation of a Cancellation and the Refund Credit
content:
**What this covers.** The refund credited when the holder of a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract — the labor-only tiers of Harbison Protection Contracts — confirms the cancellation request on file. The cancellation takes effect on the date of confirmation, and the refund is credited against the contract-price charge on the contract, or against no charge on the contract where the tier was bought on the installation contract and its price billed on the installation project.

**Basis.** A cancellation refund is not fixed until every claim filed on the contract carries its original decision. Before a cancellation refund is recorded, the contract must carry the claim service fee owed for every service call on which a claim against it was approved or partially approved.

Put another way: while any claim filed on the contract still lacks an original decision, the refund is not yet fixed; and while the claim service fee owed for a service call with an approved or partially approved claim against the contract does not yet stand on the contract, the refund is not yet recorded.

**What confirming does.** The holder's own confirmation marks the pending cancellation request confirmed, closes the contract as cancelled effective that day, posts the cancellation refund credit against the contract-price charge, and, where the credit leaves the company owing the holder money, pays that credit balance back to the original payment method so the contract balance ends at zero. The holder sees the contract cancelled, the refund credited and any payout issued right away.

### Tool: `confirm_protection_cancellation_57f0aac4`

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it for the holder with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, handing it over, and the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `warranty_request_id` | reference number of the holder's pending cancellation request, from the protection change request lookup | id |
| `contract_id` | reference number of the protection contract being cancelled, from the protection contract lookup | id |
| `source_billing_id` | reference number of the contract-price charge the refund is credited against, from the contract's billing history; an empty value where the tier was bought on the installation contract and no contract-price charge stands on the contract | id or empty |
| `refund_amount` | the cancellation refund credited, as the agent stated it to the holder | US dollars, 2 decimal places, always positive, rounded to the cent half up |

**Return.** A receipt listing `warranty_request_id`, `request_status` (confirmed), `contract_id`, `status` (cancelled), `closed_date` (today), `credit_id` (reference number of the refund credit), `refund_amount`, `payout_id` (reference number of the payout, empty when nothing is paid out), `payout_amount`, `payout_reference` (payout confirmation number, empty when nothing is paid out) and `contract_balance` (US dollars, 2 decimals, signed). A status of cancelled with a `credit_id` means the cancellation is recorded.
